items.item_text: High school diploma or equivalent (e.g. HiSET or GED)
2 years of recent phlebotomy experience or one year of in-patient phlebotomy experience
Experience with Beaker LIS/Care Connect/EPIC – preferred

Join UCLA Health's Clinical Laboratory team and play a critical role in supporting patient care through accurate and timely specimen processing. This position is primarily focused on laboratory pre-analytical functions, including specimen receipt, accessioning, processing, and preparation for testing. Key duties include:
Receive, verify, accession, and process patient specimens for laboratory testing.
Ensure specimens are appropriately labeled, handled, stored, and routed according to laboratory procedures.
Prepare specimens for transport, testing, and referral to reference laboratories.
Review requisitions and laboratory orders for completeness and accuracy.
Enter and retrieve patient and specimen information within the laboratory information system and electronic health record.
Communicate with clinical staff regarding specimen requirements, collection issues, and testing needs.
Maintain compliance with laboratory quality, safety, and regulatory standards.
Assist with inventory management and maintenance of laboratory supplies.
Perform phlebotomy duties as needed to support staffing and operational requirements.
Ability to work rotating weekends and holidays
